from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section1Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = ["Constant speed means a constant slope.", "Rise over run gives the steepness.", "Steady progress on a grid."]
        self.setup_layout("Prerequisite: The Static Slope", lecture_lines)
        
        # Pre-build objects
        axes = Axes(x_range=[0, 5, 1], y_range=[0, 5, 1], axis_config={"include_numbers": False}).scale(0.6)
        line = Line(axes.c2p(0, 0), axes.c2p(4, 3), color=WHITE)
        triangle = Polygon(axes.c2p(1, 0.75), axes.c2p(3, 0.75), axes.c2p(3, 2.25), color=WHITE, fill_opacity=0.2)
        dy = Line(axes.c2p(3, 0.75), axes.c2p(3, 2.25), color="#FF00FF")
        dx = Line(axes.c2p(1, 0.75), axes.c2p(3, 0.75), color="#FF00FF")
        dy_label = Text("Δy", font_size=20, color="#FF00FF").next_to(dy, RIGHT)
        dx_label = Text("Δx", font_size=20, color="#FF00FF").next_to(dx, DOWN)
        turtle = Dot(color="#00FF00", radius=0.1)
        slope_text = Text("Slope = Δy/Δx", font_size=24, color="#FFFF00")
        
        group = VGroup(axes, line, triangle, dy, dx, dy_label, dx_label, turtle)
        self.place_in_area(group, "A1", "F6", scale_factor=0.8)
        self.place_at_grid(slope_text, "B1")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#00FFFF")
        self.play(Create(axes), Create(line))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#FF00FF")
        self.play(Create(triangle), Create(dy), Create(dx), Write(dy_label), Write(dx_label))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#00FF00")
        self.add(turtle)
        turtle.move_to(line.get_start())
        self.play(MoveAlongPath(turtle, line), run_time=2)
        self.play(Write(slope_text))
        self.play(Flash(slope_text), Flash(slope_text), Flash(slope_text))

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("The Zooming Transformation (Secant to Tangent)", [
            "Secant line connects two points.",
            "Moving points closer reduces distance.",
            "Zooming reveals a straight line.",
            "Secant transforms into a tangent.",
            "Tangent shows instantaneous slope."
        ])

        # Define Curve: y = 0.5 * x^2
        axes = Axes(x_range=[-2, 2], y_range=[-0.5, 2], axis_config={"include_tip": False})
        curve = axes.plot(lambda x: 0.5 * x**2, color=WHITE)
        
        # Grid layout placement
        graph_group = VGroup(axes, curve)
        self.place_in_area(graph_group, 'B1', 'E6', scale_factor=0.6)

        # Points
        p_x, q_x = -1.0, 1.0
        p_point = Dot(axes.c2p(p_x, 0.5 * p_x**2), color="#FF0000")
        q_point = Dot(axes.c2p(q_x, 0.5 * q_x**2), color="#FF0000")
        
        secant = Line(p_point.get_center(), q_point.get_center(), color=WHITE)
        
        # Setup trackers
        q_tracker = ValueTracker(q_x)
        
        def update_secant(l):
            new_q = axes.c2p(q_tracker.get_value(), 0.5 * q_tracker.get_value()**2)
            q_point.move_to(new_q)
            l.put_start_and_end_on(p_point.get_center(), new_q)
            
        secant.add_updater(update_secant)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(FadeIn(p_point), FadeIn(q_point), Create(secant))
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#FF0000")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(q_tracker.animate.set_value(-0.2), run_time=2)
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#FFFF00")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Zooming/Transformation
        self.play(graph_group.animate.scale(2.5), run_time=2)
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#00FF00")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        secant.remove_updater(update_secant)
        tangent = Line(axes.c2p(-1, 0.5), axes.c2p(0, 0), color="#00FFFF")
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(secant, tangent))
        self.lecture[3].set_color("#00FFFF")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        label = Text("Tangent", color="#00FFFF", font_size=24)
        self.place_at_grid(label, 'F3')
        self.play(Write(label))
        self.lecture[4].set_color("#00FFFF")

        self.wait(2)

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Defining the Derivative as an Operator", [
            "Derivative is a slope-machine.",
            "Input curve, output slope function.",
            "Maps input to rate.",
            "Instantaneous rate of change.",
            "A dynamic new function."
        ])
        
        # Elements
        box = Square(side_length=2, color=WHITE)
        self.place_in_area(box, "B2", "C3")
        label_f = MathTex("f(x)", color=WHITE).next_to(box, LEFT)
        label_df = MathTex("f'(x)", color=WHITE).next_to(box, RIGHT)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.play(Create(box), Write(label_f), Write(label_df))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color(ORANGE)
        curve = FunctionGraph(lambda x: 0.1 * x**3, color=ORANGE, x_range=[-2, 2])
        slope_curve = FunctionGraph(lambda x: 0.3 * x**2, color=GREEN, x_range=[-2, 2])
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(curve),
            curve.animate.move_to(box.get_left()),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.play(
            FadeIn(slope_curve),
            slope_curve.animate.move_to(box.get_right()),
            run_time=2
        )

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[2].set_color(GREEN)
        dot = Dot(color=GREEN)
        self.place_at_grid(dot, "E3")
        self.play(FadeIn(dot))
        self.play(dot.animate.shift(RIGHT * 2))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.lecture[3].set_color(YELLOW)
        formula = MathTex(r"\\frac{d}{dx} [f(x)] = f'(x)", color=YELLOW)
        self.place_at_grid(formula, "B5")
        self.play(Flash(formula, color=YELLOW))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.lecture[4].set_color(WHITE)
        self.play(Indicate(box))

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Synthesis: Dynamic Interpretation", 
                          ["Velocity is the slope.", 
                           "Rate of change of position.", 
                           "Dynamic system, moving faster."])
        
        # Rocket position s(t)
        axes = Axes(x_range=[0, 4, 1], y_range=[0, 4, 1], axis_config={"include_tip": False})
        pos_curve = axes.plot(lambda t: 0.25 * t**2, color=WHITE)
        pos_group = VGroup(axes, pos_curve)
        self.place_in_area(pos_group, 'B1', 'E3', scale_factor=0.6)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#FFFFFF"), Create(pos_group))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        vel_curve = axes.plot(lambda t: 0.5 * t, color="#FF00FF")
        vel_label = Text("Derivative = Velocity", font_size=18, color="#FF00FF")
        self.place_at_grid(vel_label, 'D5')
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#FF00FF"), Create(vel_curve), Write(vel_label))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        rocket = Dot(color="#FF6600")
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#FF6600"), FadeIn(rocket))
        self.play(MoveAlongPath(rocket, pos_curve), run_time=2)
        
        final_label = Text("Calculus bridges the gap between Geometry and Physics", font_size=24, color="#00FFFF")
        self.place_at_grid(final_label, 'F3')
        self.play(FadeIn(final_label, run_time=2))
        self.wait(1)

outline.topic: The Transformational View of Derivatives: From Slopes to Dynamic Rates

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Static Slope
sections.content: Establish the foundation by visualizing a straight line on a graph. Define the slope as 'rise over run' (Δy/Δx), representing a constant rate of change.
sections.example: A turtle crawling at a steady pace: the constant steepness of its path on a coordinate grid.

sections.title: The Problem of Curvature
sections.content: Introduce a curve (non-linear function). Explain that the slope is no longer constant. We need a way to measure the 'instantaneous steepness' at a single point.
sections.example: A mountain goat climbing a curved cliffside; its steepness changes with every step it takes.

sections.title: The Zooming Transformation (Secant to Tangent)
sections.content: Visualize the secant line passing through two points (P and Q). Show an animation where point Q moves closer to P until the distance Δx becomes infinitesimally small. The secant transforms into the tangent line.
sections.example: An animated camera zooming into a curved track until the small section of the track appears as a straight line (the tangent).

sections.title: Defining the Derivative as an Operator
sections.content: Formally introduce the derivative as a transformation: it takes a function f(x) and maps it to a new function f'(x) that outputs the slope at any input x.
sections.example: A 'magic box' machine: Input the curve equation, and it outputs a new 'slope-graph' showing how steep the mountain is at every position.

sections.title: Synthesis: Dynamic Interpretation
sections.content: Conclude by shifting the perspective from 'static geometry' to 'dynamic motion.' The derivative is the rate of change of the state of a system.
sections.example: A rocket launching: The position graph is the path, while the derivative (slope) is the instantaneous velocity at any given second.
